intent: Make SRC corpus content resolution archive-first and connector-readable without exposing private body paths or weakening rights/custody boundaries.
scope: SRC query and connector interface only on amari/src-codex-spine-next-session; no source-body mutation, no canon promotion, no merge.

operations.summary: Add an archive-first connector readability contract with direct-derivative, DOI-linked, exact-title, and explicit blocker states; forbid search-engine fallback before archive resolution.
Register connector-readability as a first-class interface with typed readability states.

Add a seal-pinned read command that resolves direct derivatives first, then explicit Substack DOI links, then normalized-title-exact sibling derivatives, otherwise returns an exact human-gated or missing-derivative blocker.
Add a targeted boundary test for connector readability semantics and Python syntax.

claimCeiling: This patch improves retrieval and typed blocker reporting. It does not disclose private capture paths, grant redistribution rights, establish fuzzy work identity, prove search-engine suppression, establish CODEX_B ordinals, or promote any SRC claim into TD613 science.
rollbackConditions: Any private body path becomes publicly disclosed.
Fuzzy-title matching is used as an automatic body substitution.
A public formal capture without a derivative silently falls back to metadata or web search.
Targeted readability or boundary tests fail.
